rule: Dynasty-Rule-Oct-2025 'Salary Cap Violator' (docs/LEAGUE_RULES_MODEL.md, Cap violation ladder): payroll is checked after the draft and after the trade deadline. Under the floor at BOTH, without demonstrable improvement (payroll up from season start to end via trade or claim): +5W added to the final record. 2nd consecutive season: no add/drop in playoff week 1 and the next 1st-round pick drops one slot; 3rd: no add/drop through the playoffs and Round 1 at the end of its group. In-season adds/drops may leave the band; trades must move toward it.

checkpoints.label: Post-trade-deadline
checkpoints.note: Trade deadline is set during All-Star week. Record this checkpoint from the first verified roster snapshot after the deadline.

note: Findings are derived from the checkpoint snapshots; a penalty exists only as a recorded commissioner decision in commissionerDecisions.
